e.title: insurance-gam
e.summary: 可解释 GAM 定价（burning-cost，MIT）：EBM 费率的非线性可解释
e.body: insurance-gam（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）做可解释 GAM 定价：EBM（Explainable Boosting Machine）费率——非线性可解释（拒绝「可解释或准确二选一」）。对 RIAA：可解释非线性的现代定价——[[insurance-distill]]（蒸馏）的姊妹方法：GAM 直接可解释 vs 蒸馏后解释；与 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价）配套；「非线性 + 可解释」满足监管与实务双需求；可解释精算的课程/论文工具。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：burning-cost 仓库 + PyPI 确认（EBM 可解释 GAM 定价，MIT），未实测
e.summary_en: Interpretable GAM pricing (burning-cost, MIT): EBM tariffs with interpretable nonlinearity
e.summary_hk: 可解釋 GAM 定價（burning-cost，MIT）：EBM 費率的非線性可解釋
e.body_en: insurance-gam (burning-cost, PyPI, MIT) does interpretable GAM pricing: EBM (Explainable Boosting Machine) rates — interpretable nonlinearity (refusing the 'interpretable or accurate' trade-off). For RIAA: modern pricing with interpretable nonlinearity — a sibling of [[insurance-distill]] (distillation): GAM is directly interpretable vs distillation-then-explain; with [[machine-learning-pricing]] (ML pricing) it supports the pricing workflow; 'nonlinear + interpretable' meets both regulatory and practical needs; a course/thesis tool of explainable actuarial work.
e.body_hk: insurance-gam（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）做可解釋 GAM 定價：EBM（Explainable Boosting Machine）費率——非線性可解釋（拒絕「可解釋或準確二選一」）。對 RIAA：可解釋非線性的現代定價——[[insurance-distill]]（蒸餾）的姊妹方法：GAM 直接可解釋 vs 蒸餾後解釋；與 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定價）配套；「非線性 + 可解釋」滿足監管與實務雙需求；可解釋精算的課程/論文工具。
